core.title: Acorn Warwick Castle Tip Dummy Strap Hinges

text.description_html:
Acorn WIGBP, 24 Inch Castle Tip Dummy Strap Hinge

The 24 Inch Warwick Castle Tip Dummy Strap Hinge gives an old world charm to any home door, gate, shutter, or garage door without the need of installing actual hinges. It is a great way to change the look of your doors without having to reinstall all the existing hardware or for when working hinges would be inoperable. This decorative hinge has a rough black iron finish and a lifetime no-rust warranty. Warwick rough iron hardware duplicates the texture found on the ironwork of many old European castles and cathedrals by imitating the look and feel of natural weathered of iron. Good for interior and exterior doors.

Also Available Matching: 28" Warwick Castle Tip Dummy Strap Hinge

Specifications of the Acorn Castle Tip Dummy Strap Hinge:

  • Finish: Rough Black Iron
  • Length: 24"
  • Max Width: 10"
  • Width at hinge: 3"
  • Packaged with black finish mounting wood screws.
  • For exterior and interior use.
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty!

Sold Individually
